2.DialogText: Before you go, please accept this token of our gratitude!

1.DialogText: We won... The capital is safe.

2.DialogText: That was just the first battle. Where else might the demons be wreaking havoc?

6.DialogText: Rally! We march for the capital!

1.DialogText: The villagers have all turned into demons... This last one begs for your mercy. You decide to...

4.DialogText: It wants to take Mira away!

1.DialogText: The royal castle is under attack. Rush to the rescue!
A Light Medal? A trinket earned in blood...
The villagers are being attacked by demons!
We made it just in time!
A life saved... is a debt that must be repaid!
I've got it! The villagers are all demons!
Why can't I get through this wall?!
Mira's been captured. Quick, chase them!
Just some demons. Mere child's play!
We won... The capital is safe.
That was just the first battle. Where else might the demons be wreaking havoc?
Before you go, please accept this token of our gratitude!
I heard the capital was under attack.
Listen, the demons ahead are really strong!
Head for the north gates. We'll find our way in!
Ranhorn's just ahead! We're almost home!
First, let's clear out these freeloaders who've taken over the place!
We have to cut off the demons' reinforcements!
But that huge cannon over there...
The demons want to use it to flatten the Capital!
We finally cut off all of the demons' counterattack methods!
But the demons placed a magical barrier on the castle!
Hah! Watch me smash it to bits!
Hey, we're allies! Sorry, I misunderstood!
Sorry, the demon invasion has thrown everything into chaos.
That demon dragon is no pushover! Be careful!
If we don't destroy it, it'll enslave the citizens of Ranhorn!
With the arrival of this demon dragon, the Capital is in grave danger!
Finally made it inside! Now keep moving toward the castle!
If we were any later, the dragon would've flattened the Capital already!
Curses! The demons are here, too!
The Noble Tavern is right ahead!
There's no end to the bastards!
After the dragon took the castle, the demons have been pouring in!
We have to weaken the dragon's forces!
Those cannons will block our path to the castle!
Who cares about cannons?! We take them all out!
We're almost at the castle. Clear the path ahead!
You'll never stop us like this!
The dragon looks like it could swallow us all up...
And it placed a magical barrier on the castle!
The closer we get, the more casualties we find...
Look! Wilder allies are healing the troops!
The dragon's right before our eyes!
Kill it! Set the Capital free!
Don't disturb me as I tend to the wounded...
Who are you? Henchmen of the demons, perhaps?
Mira's been captured. Quick, chase them!
No! The demons are closing in!
The troops are right up ahead!
This place has been overrun by demons!
We'll be more efficient if we split up. I'll go ahead first.
No! Even the Noble Tavern's been overrun!
I've been waiting for you guys! Finally, I don't have to fight alone!
Clearing out these demons isn't enough. Keep pressing forward!
I never could have imagined this place being taken over by demons...
The troops are fighting for their lives!
If only it were just a nightmare...
I'll snatch a maiden and bring her back!
The elders will finally praise me!
You dare to steal my delicious meal?
Then trade your life for it, you lowly insects!
Succulent morsels... I'll savor you soon enough.
When we get to the Capital, I need to stay a step ahead!
The demons have destroyed everything here!
It's just ahead! Go and stop it!
Alone, our firepower won't be enough!

2.DialogText: We've got to find someone to help us turn the tide!

3.DialogText: I hear there's a deity in the Floating Domain...

1.DialogText: Something's glowing. I'll go check it out!

2.DialogText: Is this where we meet our end?

1.DialogText: Her blessed relics have all been scattered...

2.DialogText: Not good! Help her find them!
My divine power is nearly exhausted. Retreat, now!

1.DialogText: The crown is there. Hurry and take it!
We can't lose track of that again!
Enter the Floating Domain and Find the Deity
Enter the Floating Domain and Find the Blessed Relics
Thank you. I feel much better.
My body feels much lighter now.
And now, I must repay you...
Collect more blessed relics and purchase bundles for even better rewards.
This portal seems to be broken.
Thank you for giving me a new life.
I'll do everything I can to help you eliminate those demons!
I'm sorry. My body is too gravely wounded to appear.
But I will guide you to the blessed relics.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.
Next are the plumes. Right up ahead.
And the core's aura... It's drawing closer.
The path ahead is fraught with danger. Be careful.
Rest assured. It shall be done.
Let's go. My Lunar Skiff is just ahead.
Please bring it back to me.
And finally, only the final blessed relic remains.
Look! The bouquet is right there!
With the relics collected, you'll be healed, right?
Yes. Just please await my rebirth...
By then, another helper will have arrived...
Something's glowing. I'll go check it out!
